description.p: Blotter is a keyboard-first daily planner with an AI that pencils things in for you. Brain-dump tasks into the Inbox, then let the slot engine or the AI place them around your block-out windows, such as work hours.

ul.li: Diary, Week, Month and Year views, fully usable by keyboard
Block-out windows that flexible tasks never land in
An AI chat (Claude Code, Anthropic, OpenAI or a local model) that proposes changes for you to accept
Reminders with snooze that keep firing from the tray
ICS export, import and calendar subscriptions
A theme editor with live preview, and a keybinding editor

description.p: Holidays, task windows, weekly tasks, task context, tag management, a Consult me planning mode, Codex CLI support, drag and drop in every calendar view, a themed right-click menu and a new logo.
